methods: Combined clothing primitives0+2, original exact source aliases exclude adjacent faces; CPU Blender BVH + strict six-edge float64 crossing predicate. Edge ratios exclude rest edges shorter2mm. Cuff vertices AND edge midpoints queried against actual glove triangles.
limits: Finite pose/frame samples; no CCD or full-body certification.
Region masks fixed from source anatomy estimates.
Cuff crossing might be intended insertion; visual review mandatory.
No GPU, PBR or gray appearance claims from numeric gates.

cuff.sample_basis: complete-cloth exact-weld boundary vertices and edge midpoints
cuff.note: Overlap is not seam equality. Intended insertion may penetrate glove interior; crossing counts require garment construction review.
